correctness.rationale: The modulo-period Parikh reduction is exact. The two-run cyclic convolution has at most two phases at each non-extremal count; three distinct consecutive starts are required when the shorter residue is less than half a period. Extremal-count equality is forced to be monochromatic, and the half-period orbit has exactly two balanced phases if both runs are even. Primitivity gives factor distinctness from length p onwards. The independent brute-force construction checks 24464 parameter tuples and 404329 phase positions, but does not substitute for the proof.
